notes: Maintainer SL7 local facts for agents and humans — not product defaults.
CI must not fetch Windows media (ADR-001). This path exists only on the maintainer host.
just check never mounts or hashes this ISO.
just smoke-maintainer uses samples/sl7.profile.json (same Primary install target). Requires .scratch/sl7.password.

sourceIso.description: Official Microsoft Windows 11 25H2 English ARM64 retail/business Source ISO used for Smoke and Host Apply on SL7

smokeRecipeNote: Under PowerShell, pass the ISO as a positional just argument. Do not use ISO=path — just embeds the literal ISO= prefix into -Iso.
